definitions.gloss: majority vote; majority rule; decision by majority
definitions.explanation: A method of making decisions in which the option supported by more than half of the voters is adopted.

examples.japanese: {多数決|たすうけつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}めよう→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
{多数決|たすうけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{旅行先|りょこうさき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ハワイ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of the majority vote, Hawaii was chosen as the travel destination.

examples.japanese: {多数決|たすうけつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧しも⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導|みちび}く→導く：12361_michibiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: A majority vote doesn't necessarily lead to the right conclusion.

notes:
{多数決|たすうけつ} is composed of ⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧ (majority) and {決|けつ} (decision). It refers specifically to the principle or method of deciding by majority.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多数決|たすうけつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (to decide by majority vote)
- {多数決|たすうけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take a vote)
- {多数決|たすうけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原理|げんり}→原理：00066_genri⟧ (the principle of majority rule)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧: voting, balloting — the act of casting a vote (broader than majority rule)
- ⟦{挙手|きょしゅ}→挙手：16852_kyoshu⟧: raising hands — a common method for conducting a {多数決|たすうけつ}
- ⟦{全会一致|ぜんかいいっち}→全会一致：09760_zenkaiicchi⟧: unanimous decision — the opposite approach, requiring all to agree
